### The Role of Auditing and Financial Integrity

Independent audits are a critical component of modern financial systems, designed to ensure that financial statements accurately reflect a company's financial position. Auditors follow strict standards, such as the International Standards on Auditing (ISA) or the Generally Accepted Auditing Standards (GAAS), to verify the accuracy and completeness of financial records.
